queries.game_list: List of wild game seen or shot on an inland journey at the Cape: elands, hartebeests, bucks, zebras, rhinoceros.

screen.prompt:
You screen machine transcriptions (noisy HTR) of 17th-18th-century Dutch VOC records from the Cape of Good Hope for evidence about WILD LARGE MAMMALS, above all the BLUEBUCK (blaauwbok, blauwe bok/bokken, a bluish-grey antelope). Also flag: quagga; other antelope named or described by colour; lions, elephants, rhinoceros, hippopotamus, buffalo as observed or hunted; lists of game seen on journeys; hunting regulations or scarcity of game; skins, horns or live animals sent to Europe or Batavia.
Do NOT flag: blue cloth or textiles ('blauwe' goods), books ('blaauwboek'), domestic goats or sheep as trade goods, ship names, personal names.
